title: Fishers and coastal villagers march against Mumbai desalination plant
seoTitle: Mumbai march against Manori desalination plant

tea.why: Protesters oppose the BMC's proposed Manori desalination plant, citing threats to marine biodiversity and traditional fishing livelihoods.
tea.want: Demonstrators demand that the municipal corporation scrap the proposed desalination project and address water leakages first.
tea.changed: Oct 19: Fishermen, villagers, and activists organized a march to the Mumbai Suburban Collector's office in Bandra.

summary: Fishermen, coastal villagers, and environmental activists have organized a protest march to the Mumbai Suburban Collector's office in Bandra to oppose the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation's proposed desalination plant at Manori. The protest is supported by organizations including the Gorai Villagers Welfare Association, Akhil Maharashtra Machhimar Kruti Samiti, Maharashtra Machhimar Kriti Samiti, and the Bombay Catholic Sabha. Participants argue that the project threatens marine life and traditional fishing grounds, claiming that authorities failed to conduct proper public consultations or discuss the environmental impact assessment with local communities. Instead of building the plant, the protesters demand that the administration focus on fixing water leakages and theft. According to source reports, approximately 2,000 people were expected to join the demonstration.
demands: Scrap the proposed Manori desalination plant
Consult local fishing communities before launching coastal projects
Prioritize plugging water leakages and addressing water theft instead of building the plant
response: No official response reported in the sources.

crowd.text: around 2000 people, including the villagers, farmers, fishermen and activists are expected to join the protest

updates.text: Locals organized a protest that led authorities to agree to talk with the community, according to organizers.
Participants at a meeting in Gorai decided to hold the march to oppose the seawater intake and brine discharge.
Fishermen, villagers, and activists called for the 'Chalo Bandra' march at the Mumbai Suburban Collector's office.
